basic_info.description: Spectacular top floor unit adjacent to the State Street Playground. Property has full width balcony, tons of light and fantastic City and Bay views. The main flat is 3BR/2BA and includes a separate, legal, zen-garden studio apartment- see photos. Main unit has open floor plan, gas fireplace and additional park view off the west side. Huge garage with 2 car parking and room for storage. The property has been lovingly maintained by the current owner who also made many upgrades for the sale, please see listing agent for details. In a peaceful setting but convenient to all the amenities and restaurants in the Duboce Triangle and Market-Castro. The entire 2-unit property is vacant and 28 Flint can be sold with 30 Flint for $4,250,000, see MLS for details on that listing.
